about: A person who must tie their hair back: c09 leaves out cuts that cannot be tied. c09-b, which also left out chin and bob lengths that can be tied, was retired.

why.excluded.wavy-lob: it ties back at collarbone length, so nothing leaves it out (c09-b retired)

about: Curly hair, shoulder length now, resting at the chin: b02 notes high-shrinkage chin and bob cuts; feasibility reads the length band and the texture fit.

why.notes.curly-bob-with-fringe: shrinkage_risk high and a chin perimeter: b02's on holds and its when (texture curly, both lengths known) holds
why.notes.curly-wolf-cut: high shrinkage but a shoulder perimeter, outside b02's chin and bob
why.feasibility.curly-bob-with-fringe: longest zone top 13-20 cm needs 13 cm, inside the shoulder band 22-38; curly fit good
why.feasibility.tapered-twa: needs 3 cm (today by length) but its curly fit is adapt
why.feasibility.long-one-length-blunt: its back zone needs 48 cm, above the shoulder band's 38 (after growth wins over its curly adapt fit)

about: Fine strands and low density: only b09 (moderate, weight 2) scores cuts; its reason names the first two favour values the item matched.

blunt-chin-bob: Your hair is fine and not very thick, so this cut has blunt ends and one length without layers.

why.scores.blunt-chin-bob: favour perimeter blunt (also layers none and the chin length); no disfavour: +2
why.scores.classic-pixie: favour light layers and the short length class: +2
why.scores.long-curtain-layers: soft perimeter, long layers, long length: no match
why.reasons.blunt-chin-bob: b09's reason plus the phrases of its first two matching favour values, in list order

about: The fullness-at-the-sides wish (a01, group A, weight 2) with no photo, beside a long trim interval: the wish acts as stated and counts in full (no group cap, no face key); c04 is gone, since the trim factor and the trim exclusion do its job.

why.scores.long-curtain-layers: a01 favours the curtain fringe: +2, uncapped
why.scores.wolf-cut: a01 favours its curtain fringe and disfavours its crown volume: 0

about: The same measured longer face with no wish: every group-A rule is wish-gated, so nothing scores.

why.scores.long-curtain-layers: a01, a02 and a26 need wish.face_length, which is absent

about: Wavy hair styled with heat every day: the caution b37 shows on heat-dependent cuts and suppresses b04 there, and only there.

why.scores.blunt-chin-bob: heat-dependent, so b37 applies and b04 is skipped on it
why.scores.wavy-lob: not heat-dependent: b04 favours its wavy fit, long layers and lob shape: +2
why.scores.long-one-length-blunt: b04 disfavours its blunt_sleek perimeter: -2 (its wavy-fit favour is gone: the texture factor owns the fit)

about: Hair at the chin now (14-22 cm): cuts whose longest zone needs more than 22 cm come after growth.
Wavy hair: a cut the library marks poor for waves, or shaped for curls, is left out, not ranked down (an authored poor fit is an exclusion now; the texture factor ranks good above adapt).

why.excluded.afro-burst-taper: poor for waves, and a curl-first shape
why.scores.wavy-lob: b04 favours long layers and the lob shape: +2

about: Wavy hair, a cut every 2-4 weeks: a buzz or crew cut earns no line about waves, and no 'blunt ends' reason.

why.scores.buzz-cut-women: b04 skips buzz and crew shapes; c05 no longer favours blunt ends; its sides and fringe match nothing else
why.scores.crew-cut-classic: its taper is not a fade c05 names; b04 skips crew shapes

about: Long hair, change amount not asked: the change factor (unknown row) holds a large change back, so the first pick keeps a length near hers; c15-large-change-default is gone, the factor does its job.

why.first_pick.cut: the unknown row gives 1 for 0-1 classes and 0.5 for three or more
why.scores.buzz-cut-women: no rank rule reads the change any more

about: Long hair, 'Noticeable but wearable': the change factor favours one class of change and holds a large one back (c15-large-change is gone).

why.first_pick.cut: the noticeable row: 1 for one class, 0.5 for three or more
why.scores.buzz-cut-women: no rank rule reads the change

about: Long hair, 'Subtle': a big chop is left out (subtle-no-big-chop), a cut at her length is offered, and nothing counts the change twice.

why.excluded.buzz-cut-women: very_short from long is a large change shorter
why.first_pick.cut: the subtle row gives 1 for no change and 0.95 for one class

about: Long hair, 'Bold': the change factor favours two or more classes off, so the first pick is a clear change (c16 is gone, the factor does its job).

why.first_pick.cut: the bold row: 1 for two classes, 0.95 for three or more, 0.5 for none
why.excluded.buzz-cut-women: a big change is what was asked

about: Short hair, 'Bold', growing out not answered: cuts that need growth stay eligible as future options, after the shapes that work today and at most two, up to a year of growth (a growth wait is a trade-off for someone not growing out; it was once an exclusion; the one-year limit holds for everyone).

why.excluded.long-curtain-layers: needs 42 cm, 32 cm more: more than a year of growth, left out whoever asks
why.excluded.curly-mullet-salon: a shoulder-length shape needs the shoulder band's start, 22 cm: a growth wait within a year, a trade-off
why.feasibility.long-curtain-layers: 42 cm is above the middle of the short band, 10 cm
why.feasibility.curly-mullet-salon: 22 cm is above the middle of the short band, 10 cm

about: Wavy, short hair, 'Wash and go' (a case that gave only cuts needing 26 weeks or more): our pick works today, later places may need growth.

why.first_pick.cut: an after-growth cut is never first while a cut works today by length; texture_fit poor is held back by texture-poor-fit

about: The current length is not answered: no feasibility line.
